note: MEASURED 2026-11-01 ~09:22Z by Manager Session 2026-11-01a (3-hourly check-in): #22029 head bea62339 check runs: guards FAILURE (job 124747177186, run 41272228146), pytest-run / pytest-collect / repo-inventory success. KNOWN RESIDUAL (producer, not fixed): the soak-report pipeline sync dedupes only against main, so every un-landed run re-emits the same 45 PI-SOAK items; I dropped the duplicates from three PRs by hand.
